avoid_supplements.name: Red Yeast Rice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains lovastatin and monacolin K; additive statin effects increase myopathy and rhabdomyolysis risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue red yeast rice; monitor CK levels if prior use

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Niacin (>2g daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increased risk of myopathy and statin-induced muscle injury when combined with pravastatin
avoid_supplements.action: Use only low-dose niacin (<1g daily) with close CK monitoring or avoid combination

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Statins reduce CoQ10 synthesis; supplementation may support muscle function but may reduce statin efficacy slightly
caution_supplements.action: Consider 100-200 mg daily; monitor lipid panel for efficacy maintenance

caution_supplements.name: Fish Oil/Omega-3 (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive antiplatelet effects and increase bleeding risk in susceptible patients
caution_supplements.action: Limit to ≤3g daily; counsel on bleeding signs

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate antiplatelet and anticoagulant effects; minor interaction with pravastatin metabolism
caution_supplements.action: Moderate intake acceptable; advise patient of cumulative antiplatelet effect

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition; pravastatin is minimally metabolized by CYP3A4 (undergoes glucuronidation), so interaction is minor compared to other statins
caution_foods.action: Occasional consumption is likely safe; excessive intake (>1L daily) warrants avoidance

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (excessive)
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase statin myopathy risk and impair hepatic metabolism; increases transaminase elevations
caution_foods.action: Limit to ≤1-2 drinks daily; counsel on liver function monitoring

monitoring_notes: Pravastatin has minimal CYP3A4 interaction potential due to primary glucuronidation metabolism, making it safer than other statins with supplements. Monitor for muscle pain, weakness, and elevated CK levels, especially if patient is on concurrent myopathy-risk medications or high-dose niacin.
